T01.message: Reflex typeface used as the first family
T01.fix: Pick a face by character class (references/reflex-lists.md); if this face is a deliberate choice, record it under AWARDS.md ## Exceptions

T02.fix: Self-host the woff2 files with font-display and a size-adjusted fallback

T03.message: Display size above 12vw or unclamped vw
T03.fix: Lock display type to the artboard with clamp(min, Xvw, max), max ≈ 12–13vw

T04.fix: Tracking floor is -0.04em; tighter values collide at display sizes

T05.fix: Add font-display: swap (or optional for decorative faces) to avoid invisible text

T06.fix: Declare a metric-compatible fallback with size-adjust/ascent-override to avoid reflow when the real face lands

C01.fix: Adjust ink or ground; large text may use 3:1, body needs 4.5:1

C02.fix: Use a warm or cool near-black/off-white unless pure black is diegetic; record diegetic use under AWARDS.md ## Exceptions

C03.message: More than 6 distinct hues in the tokens
C03.fix: Winners run 2–4 tokens; variety comes from change over time, not simultaneity

C04.fix: Emphasis comes from weight, size or a colour field, not background-clip: text

M01.fix: Add a reduced tier (no spatial movement; keep opacity/colour/state) via CSS media query and gsap.matchMedia / matchMedia in JS

M02.message: Global 0.01ms animation kill under reduced motion
M02.fix: Reduced motion is a tier, not a kill switch: keep feedback and state transitions

M03.message: Scrubbed tween with an ease other than none
M03.fix: Scroll-linked tweens must use ease: 'none'; the scrub value supplies the smoothing

M04.fix: Apply will-change only during a known animation and only to the moving element

M05.message: CSS scroll-behavior: smooth together with a smooth-scroll library
M05.fix: Remove scroll-behavior: smooth; Lenis owns scrolling

M06.message: pin: true used alongside position: sticky
M06.fix: Prefer sticky stages with invisible rails; if pinning, do not also make the element sticky

M07.fix: Animate transforms, clip-path or use FLIP; layout properties force reflow every frame

M08.message: Infinite loop without a visibility/intersection pause
M08.fix: Pause repeat:-1 loops when the tab is hidden or the element is off-screen

A01.fix: Wrap the page content in <main>; add <header>/<nav>/<footer> where they exist

A02.fix: Write alt text (or alt="" for decorative images)

A03.message: Heading structure broken (no h1, several h1, or skipped levels)
A03.fix: One h1 per page; no skipped levels; visual size comes from CSS, not from the heading level

A04.message: <canvas> without aria-hidden or an accessible name
A04.fix: Mark decorative canvases aria-hidden="true" and keep a semantic DOM mirror of any text drawn in WebGL

A05.fix: Use <button> or <a>; they come with keyboard and focus behaviour for free

A06.fix: Theme the focus ring from the tokens; it is a browser surface that carries the design

A07.message: outline: none without a replacement focus style
A07.fix: Keep :focus-visible styling when removing default outlines

A08.message: Custom cursor without a coarse-pointer guard
A08.fix: Enable custom cursors only under (pointer: fine) and (hover: hover); hide them on touch

A10.fix: Autoplay requires muted and playsinline; add a poster and respect reduced motion

A11.message: Pointer-only interaction (drag/hold) without a keyboard handler
A11.fix: Every gesture needs a keyboard equivalent (arrow keys, Enter/Space, Escape)

L01.fix: Use fluid widths, max-width or vw-locked values

L02.message: 100vw width can overflow with a vertical scrollbar
L02.fix: Use 100% or inline-size with overflow-x: clip on the container

L04.message: Identical card grid (icon + heading + text × n)
L04.fix: Cards are the lazy container; vary structure by content or use a list, a rail or poster blocks

L05.fix: Delete the label; let the heading carry its own weight (numbering only when the sequence carries meaning)

P01.fix: Set width/height (or aspect-ratio) to avoid layout shift; lazy-load images below the fold

P02.fix: Export WebP/AVIF at the display size; keep the largest image under ~300 KB

P03.message: glTF/GLB without Draco or Meshopt compression in the loader
P03.fix: Compress with gltf-transform (draco/meshopt) and textures to KTX2; wire DRACOLoader/KTX2Loader

P04.fix: Split WebGL and heavy libraries into lazy chunks; target ≈ 200 KB gz for the entry

P05.message: Too many or too heavy font files
P05.fix: Subset to the used ranges, ship ≤ 4 woff2 files, ≤ 400 KB total, preload the display face

P06.message: Uncapped devicePixelRatio for a WebGL renderer
P06.fix: renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2)) and cap the absolute pixel count on mobile

P07.message: WebGL renderer created without any dispose()
P07.fix: Dispose geometries, materials, textures and the renderer on route change

S03.fix: Add <meta name="theme-color"> from the ground token

S05.fix: Ship an SVG favicon in the world's ink

S06.fix: Author an OG image in the same world (1200×630)

X01.message: Generic CTA copy (Get started / Learn more)
X01.fix: Name the action in the product's own words, matched to the stakes

X02.fix: Author real content at full fidelity; label synthetic material

X03.fix: Use a drawn icon set with one stroke weight, or no icon

X04.message: backdrop-filter on many selectors (glass by default)
X04.fix: Glass is a specific effect, not a surface style; keep it to one earned moment

X05.fix: Depth comes from luminance or optics unless the world is actually neo-brutalist

X06.message: Thick coloured side border on a card or callout
X06.fix: Remove the stripe; group by proximity and hierarchy instead

X07.fix: Keep numbers only when the sequence carries meaning for the reader

X08.fix: Numbers persuade as copy inside sentences (dual units, specifics), not as a stat row
